bayts.text: O Possessor of Existence, Permanence and Beginninglessness, O Possessor of Dissimilarity (to creatures), accept the services from me.
O Possessor of Self-Subsistence forever and of Oneness, O You to Whom alone is my address.
You are Possessor of Power and Will, of Knowledge, Life and benefit,
of Hearing, Sight and Speech, O You Who through the Chosen efface my pains.
You are Powerful, Willing, Knowing, Living, Hearing: You have removed the wrongs.
You are Seeing, Speaking: You drew His glorious Book to me, and it was drawn.
To You (belongs), without falsehood, the essential (attribute, nafsiyya), O You Who spared me the darknesses of the soul.
To You, without dispute, the negative (attributes, salbiyya), O You Who spared me the darknesses of the heart.
To You, without partner, the entitative (attributes, maʿānī) and the derived (attributes, maʿnawiyya), without helper.
O Doer, by Whose leave the decree flows, toward others than Your Aḥmad You drove this turbidity.
By the standing of Aḥmad, the noble, the banner, O You Who through him taught what (man) did not know (Qurʾān 96:5).
O Possessor of Existence, Permanence and Beginninglessness, for the Throne and the Footstool accept these services.
